messages:
Maya: quick question — thinking about adding a "runway" fallback tier in rollout configs. idea is a soft-safety net that silently shifts traffic when primary variant degrades, then surfaces a console hint. thoughts? :thinking_face:
Liam: +1 to console hint. We should show the exact fallback chain and the reason code on the rollout page, not buried in logs. :eyes:
Anya: telemetry needs: fallback_count, fallback_rate(p50/p95/p99 by route), avg_latency_before_fallback, and capacity_headroom. we need those in the rollout timeline graph.
Samir: sketch of a policy snippet we used in staging (YAML):
```yaml
rollout:
  traffic_split: 5%->new,95%->canary
  runway_tier:
    enabled: true
    trigger:
      - type: latency_p95
        threshold_ms: 800
      - type: error_rate
        threshold_pct: 2.5
    order: [model_variant, region, capacity_backup]
    max_shift_per_min: 10%
```
Samir: runway_tier would auto-shift incremental traffic to the fallback target, not full swap, to preserve gradualness.
Chen: how does this interact with quotas and per-customer rate limits? e.g., shifting to a regional fallback might hit a different quota pool. need preflight checks or a prediction step.
Maya: good point. propose a preflight stage that simulates quota delta and highlights potential rate-limit conflicts in the console before enabling runway. UI shows warnings if >=1 route likely to exceed quota.
Liam: UX idea: add a tiny inline hint on the A/B slider: "Runway enabled — will auto-shift to X on degradation". Click opens a compact explainer with the policy and recent metric signals.
Anya: add a circuit-breaker rule: if runway_fallback_rate > 20% in 10m AND new_variant_success_rate < baseline - 5% then stop runway and alert oncall. Also capture a sample of failed responses for quick triage.
Samir: ops integration: deploy-bot can annotate the rollout with the active runway policy and a unique id so downstream jobs + incident pages can link. sample command: `deploy-bot annotate <rollout-id> runway:enabled:xyz123`
deploy-bot: deployment 2076543205 started for feature/new-routing (canary 5%). runway policy attached: xyz123
ops-eye-bot: FYI — simulated preflight shows potential quota spike for EU region if runway shifts >40% traffic. threshold warning emitted. :warning:
Maya: ok next steps: (1) add telemetry buckets mentioned by Anya, (2) implement preflight quota sim, (3) console hint + policy viewer, (4) add circuit-breaker + annotated deploys. I'll draft a short RFC and wire up a minimal UI mock. thanks all! :thumbsup:
